book.title: Black Elk Speaks: Being the Life Story of a Holy Man of the Oglala Sioux
book.description: The most important aspect of this book is upon the contemporary generation of young Indians who have been aggressively searching for roots of their own in the structure of universal reality. They look to it for spiritual guidance, for sociological identity, for political insight, and the affirmation of the continuing substance of Indian tribal life.
